reply:
403 Forbidden is correct. A logged-in user has valid credentials (401 territory), but lacks permission to access that resource (403 territory).

The distinction matters: 401 tells a client "retry with auth", 403 tells it "this user can't have this, full stop".

grade.note: Reply abandons 401 and correctly adopts 403 with proper reasoning about auth vs permission.
